Q: Building a Custom Read-Only iSCSI Target on Windows (Physical Disk Export) A:

The built in iSCSI initiator driver will handle all the low level stuff for you. As a target you can focus on implementing the iSCSI protocol. Technically your target does not even need to run on Windows. Note that if you try to implement a loopback iSCSI target you run the risk of deadlocks due to paging issues.

Q: How to make LDAP user ID case sensitive in Microsoft Active Directory A:

As Mathias has already suggested, Active Directory is "case aware" not "case sensitive" for almost all attributes. Which means it will respect the cases you enter (E.G "John Smith" rather than "john smith") but pays no attention to that case when filtering. Further detail on this can be found in this technet article.
